title: Qwen New AI Glasses N1 Debuts in Secured Style: First to Support Iris Recognition Without a Display

content_html:
The new Qwen AI glasses appear at the 2026 Bund Tech Conference AI payment exhibition area. The glasses are largely covered with black shielding material, making it difficult to determine more functions and hardware details for now.

According to Sina Technology, the product is named "N1" and will introduce iris recognition for the first time, with an error rate below one in a million. It can track eye movements to interact with checkout devices in complex environments, and verify identity just by wearing it.

According to the exhibition staff, since the new glasses do not have a display, their pricing may be cheaper than that of S1.

Since the beginning of this year, Qwen has been continuously advancing its AI hardware product layout. Previously, it has successively launched new AI glasses such as S1 and G1. At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference held in July, Qwen also demonstrated a series of new technologies, including full-duplex voice, eye movement tracking, and vital sign monitoring. These technologies may be gradually applied to subsequent new hardware products.
